critical_code_review_comments: server.py client-stats uses `user.get(key)` to compute missing_fields, but `user` from Depends(current_user) may be stale after PUT within same request context (n/a for cross-request testing; verified after PUT+GET separately — completion_pct did rise correctly).

client-profile-body.tsx is 582 lines — under 700-line threshold, but approaching. Consider splitting sub-components (SectionCard/StatCell/VerifyRow/DocRow/QuickCard) into a separate file if this grows further.
avg_response_hours and ontime_payment_pct in me_client_stats are demo proxies (`75 + count%25`, hardcoded by rating tier). Fine for MVP; document as such.
